## Where it comes from

<!-- For a fact: where you saw it in game (place, War Level, what happened), or the mod file that sets it.

---

The pages in `docs/` are generated from the mod author's master copy. Once merged, your change is copied into that
copy so the next rebuild keeps it; the wording may be adjusted to match the rest of the wiki. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
